headline: Language-model embeddings paired with physical priors predict binding, kinetics and stability
label: Physics Aware Language Models For
summary: Recent papers pair pretrained sequence embeddings with physical constraints, local geometry and uncertainty estimates for affinity, kinetics and ΔΔG prediction.
synthesis: The dominant thread is pairing pretrained sequence or molecular language-model embeddings with physical or chemical inductive biases for interaction and stability endpoints. FamGeo-DDG combines ESM-2, DSSP features and mutation-centered local geometry; MutBindPred enforces antisymmetric constraints on mutation-induced ΔΔG; BlindDDG casts stability as direction-of-change classification with a Siamese network. MGCA couples ESM2 with Morgan fingerprints in a cross-attention mixture-of-experts for Koff, and RAVEN combines frozen random graph reservoirs with physics-informed interaction fingerprints. STORM and SIREN predict binding without structure, the latter for RNA-small molecule pairs from sequence alone. Newer elements are explicit symmetry constraints, kinetic endpoints, structure-free or frozen backbones, and dependence-aware conformal prediction for 3D docking uncertainty. GABIF and Pep2Tcr extend these ideas to guided generation of antibody and TCR sequences.
